geometry_schema_notes.capsule_authority: For capsule_along_3d_axis, axis_xyz_cell_cell_step and radius_cells define the solid. The radius is isotropic in world distance; convert cell radius to z steps by cell_feet / elevation_step_feet (here both5ft, so the numerical radius is unchanged).
geometry_schema_notes.capsule_z_steps: On capsules, z_steps is the centerline axis interval, not the radius-expanded solid z bounds. A horizontal crossbar may therefore have [z,z] while its actual solid spans z +/- radius_steps. Derive complete bounds from the axis plus radius; XY polygons are guides and may omit rounded end caps.
geometry_schema_notes.composite_geometry: Explicit panel quads/extrusion and wheel annular rim/hub/spoke axes define the proposed member unions. Do not fill their XY/z envelopes or gaps.
geometry_schema_notes.evidence: All added physical member dimensions, panel vertices and spoke counts are qualified authoring proposals/visual estimates; immutable source media metadata remains separate.
